food.title: Food
food.description: Menus from the Studierendenwerk Hamburg mensas at Berliner Tor, Bergedorf and Finkenau. Student prices by default, with settings for allergens and food labels.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Your classes at a glance, built from the calendars you have imported.

calendar.title: Calendar and semester dates
calendar.description: Import an .ics file or an export link from myHAW, check the preview and refresh calendars when needed. Semester dates are in the app too.

map.title: Map
map.description: Search for a campus, an address or a building such as BT7. The map covers Berliner Tor, Bergedorf, Finkenau and Armgartstraße. Directions open in your maps app.

events.title: HAW events and news
events.description: Events and news from the HAW website, right in the app.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Browse listings without an account. To create a listing, contact someone or report a listing, you need an account.

clubs.title: Clubs
clubs.description: Look through student clubs and initiatives at HAW Hamburg.

quicklinks.title: Quick links
quicklinks.description: Quick access to links such as myHAW, Moodle, email and the library catalogue.

description.part1: HAWConnect is built and maintained by students. It is an independent project: HAW Hamburg does not run or endorse it.
description.part2: The source code is open on GitHub. You can read it, report bugs or contribute yourself.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Short answers about accounts, data, calendars and menus.

questions.question: Do I need an account?
questions.answer: No. Choose "Continue as guest" to use HAWConnect without one. Your calendars and preferences then stay on your device.

questions.question: How do I sign in?
questions.answer: Sign in on account.hawconnect.de with your HAWConnect account: email address and password. A new account is confirmed with a 6-digit code from the email. You do not need your myHAW password. Signing in requires the account and email service to be available.

questions.question: Where is my data stored?
questions.answer: In guest mode, only on your device. If you sign in and sync, calendars and preferences are sent to the HAWConnect service and stored there encrypted.

questions.question: How do I import my timetable?
questions.answer: Open Calendar, then its settings and "Import / manage calendars". Pick an .ics file from myHAW or paste an export link, check the preview and confirm. Never enter your university password. An imported file is a snapshot; import a new one to get changes.

questions.question: Where does the menu data come from?
questions.answer: From the Studierendenwerk Hamburg, for the Berliner Tor, Bergedorf and Finkenau mensas. An empty day can mean the mensa is closed or the menu is not published yet. Missing allergen information means "unknown", not "allergen-free". For binding information, ask the Studierendenwerk or the staff on site.

questions.question: Is HAWConnect in the App Store or on Google Play?
questions.answer: Not available yet. The web app already works in your browser.

questions.question: Is HAWConnect an official HAW Hamburg app?
questions.answer: No. HAWConnect is an independent student project. For binding information, such as semester dates, check with HAW Hamburg.
